title: Chapter 219: Heaven-Repairing Stone
content:
Chapter 219: Heaven-Repairing Stone

When everyone heard Xiao Mo's words, they finally reacted.

"Brother Xiao Mo is right. If my Xiao clan is really finished, what's the point of going out?"

The old man with gray hair in Xiao chose to support Xiao Mo.

Seeing this, everyone present at Xiao clan also responded.

"Then let's smash it!"

"Anyway, I've been alone enough. Instead of waiting for death here, it's better to give it a try!"

"Miss Lu, let's make a big deal. We will bear all the consequences together."

In front of the jade, listening to everyone's words, Lu Xue also sighed in her heart that the cohesion of a family was aroused.

This is the core of a truly powerful force.

"good!"

Lu Xue nodded heavily, then held the star-breaking hammer in his hand.

That moment just now was just Lu Xue's temptation.

This time, Lu Xue will do her best.

"Broken it to me!"

Lu Xue used all her strength and then suddenly smashed the jade in front of her.

Buzz —

However, the terrifying roar did not sound.

Everyone was slightly stunned and looked in front of Lu Xue with horror.

I saw that at this time the space in front of Lu Xue suddenly condensed, and the divine hammer in Lu Xue's hand was also solidified in front of the jade and could no longer move.

"presumptuous!"

"Who dares to stop the big affairs of my Xiao clan?!"

The powerful Xiao clan present burst out their terrifying aura, and for a moment, the entire Xiao clan ancestral land began to shake.

It can be seen that after the accumulation of thousands of years, how terrifying power has been condensed in the Xiao clan's ancestral land.

At this moment, a peaceful voice sounded from the field, like a magical sound, instantly calming the anxious mood of everyone present.

"Breaking this stone is not the only way to leave here."

As soon as these words came out, everyone present was stunned.

But Lu Xue in front of the jade was both surprised and happy.

"father!"

In the distance, two figures slowly walked from the fog, and one of them was Lu Daosheng.

"father?"

Everyone was confused, but at this time, Xiao Sheng beside Lu Daosheng was already filled with tears.

"I, Xiao clan, have no worries!"

.........

Half a day ago.

As Lu Daosheng and Xiao Sheng walked into the Xiao clan's ancestral land together, Xiao Sheng's spirit was never relaxed.

"This fog is not simple."

"Fellow Daoist, you really don't need to take risks. Now you may still have time to go back."

Yu Guang glanced at Lu Daosheng, and Xiao Sheng looked solemn.

Hearing Xiao Sheng’s reminder, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

"Brother, let it go, there is no danger here."

No danger?

Xiao Sheng looked around suspiciously. With his ninth level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, he could only detect things within a range of 100 meters, which made him feel at ease.

Is this also called no danger?

At this moment, Xiao Sheng didn't know that Lu Daosheng beside him had already covered his spiritual sense throughout the ancestral land. Seeing his daughter confronting the powerful people of the Xiao clan, Lu Daosheng suddenly showed a hint of relief.

Turning back to look at Xiao Sheng again, Lu Daosheng's mood became much better.

"You Xiao clan, you are about to stand out."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Upon hearing this, Xiao Sheng frowned slightly, "What do you mean by fellow Taoist?"

The Xiao clan is even about to be exterminated now. How can it be seen that it is about to stand out?

Lu Daosheng continued to laugh and said, "You said, if the strong men who have entered the ancestral land for thousands of years have returned to the Xiao clan, what will happen to you Xiao clan?"

Hearing this, Xiao Sheng said immediately, "Then I, Xiao clan, will surely make a fortune, and there is no problem even if I sweep the fairyland."

Although this is a bit exaggerated.

But Xiao Sheng also felt that it was almost done.

After all, over the past tens of millions of years, there have been many powerful people in his Xiao clan who have entered the ancestral land, and there are several of them. Even in the entire fairyland, they are all famous strong people.

But at this moment, Lu Daosheng smiled but said nothing.

Seeing this, Xiao Sheng's eyes widened.

"You, what do you mean?"

"You'll know when you go in."

Lu Daosheng continued to go ahead, while Xiao Sheng was already standing there, his face full of shock.

Is it true? !

......

At this moment, looking at so many powerful Xiao clans in front of him, Xiao Sheng could no longer suppress his tears.

Tears are everywhere.

Throughout history, those who have been able to enter the ancestral land of the Xiao clan either have high moral character or have made great contributions to the family.

And these people have one thing in common, that is, they are all top strong men of the Xiao clan.

Now, as Lu Daosheng said.

These people are actually alive.

Xiao Sheng seemed to have a dream now. Before entering the ancestral land, everything was still in despair, but now, he suddenly opened the fog and saw the moon bright.

"Xiao Sheng, why did you come in too?"

Seeing Xiao Sheng, Xiao Mo, the current leader of the Xiao clan, was shocked.

If Xiao Sheng comes in, will the Xiao clan outside be finished?

As far as he knows, the only person in the Xiao clan who can still be on the table is Xiao Sheng.

This is also the reason why Xiao Mo dared to enter the ancestral land at the beginning.

But now, Xiao Sheng has actually come in too.

Hearing Xiao Mo's words, Xiao Sheng smiled bitterly and said, "I am already a dying person. Can't I enter the ancestral land yet?"

As soon as these words came out, Xiao Mo was shocked.

The other strong men present also saw the clues.

Xiao Sheng, his life span is not much.

Just as someone was about to ask Xiao Sheng what happened to the Xiao clan outside, Xiao Yin suddenly said, "Fellow Taoist, what you said just now, is it not the only way to leave here? "

Suddenly, everyone reacted and then looked at Lu Daosheng beside Xiao Sheng.

When everyone saw this, they looked solemn.

No one present could see Lu Daosheng at all.

Even the cultivation level is not visible.

And the only thing they could see was that Lu Daosheng was not a member of their Xiao tribe.

At this time, Lu Xue had already put away her hammer and ran to Lu Daosheng.

"Dad, aren't you coming? Why are you here again?"

Lu Xue looked at her father with a smile.

Lu Daosheng listened to his daughter joking at him, and then he played Lu Xue with a broken head, "You are doing very well, let me do it next."

Immediately, Lu Xue covered her head and walked to the side with anger.

"Hmph, you're the one who's great."

Lu Daosheng ignored Lu Xue anymore, but ignored the eyes of the Xiao people present and came straight to the jade stone.

"The Sky-Buying Stone? I didn't expect to meet it here."

Looking at the jade in front of him, Lu Daosheng was a little surprised.

When the other Xiao tribe heard Lu Daosheng's words, they finally knew the name of the stone that had trapped them for millions of years.

The Heaven-Brushing Stone.

"Fellow Daoist, can you really help me leave here?"

The old man with gray hair in Xiao looked at Lu Daosheng and said.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Don't get me wrong, I just want this Sky-Repairing Stone. I'm just helping you, it's just by the way."
